name: nest_finale
where: последняя сцена: всё нашлось, все счастливы
text:
Use the attached images as the exact reference for characters, places and style. Indoors always the same classroom as in the attached classroom image: the NATURAL WOOD puppet theater (light wood, two posts with round knobs, the top board is ONE smooth round arch – not wavy) on the big table with the red tablecloth, the window with the caterpillar's plant on the LEFT. Children's picture-book illustration in exactly the same style, landscape 3:2. No text, no letters, no numbers, no stars anywhere. Mila has no backpack. The hand puppets are a fox, a bear and a king – never a mouse (the only mouse in the book is Oskar's small grey PAPER mouse). The moon is always a FULL ROUND flat cardboard disc (never a crescent): yellow on the front, white on the back.
The caterpillar's antenna tips are plain yellow-green, NOT glowing.
Happy final scene at the open classroom window: Mila, Ben, Oskar and Frau Sommer lean out and look down into the nest of white paper strips in the fork of the tree. Frau Sommer carefully takes out the white ribbon with ONE single small silver key (clearly a key, not coins, nothing golden or coin-like in or around the nest); the tree fork and the nest must look exactly like in the attached picture baum_nest (two thin branches forming a V right below the window, nest woven from white paper strips); next to the nest she lays a fresh white paper strip as a present for the bird. On the windowsill the caterpillar smiles, holding her dewdrop magnifier. Warm afternoon light, everyone relieved and happy.
redo: Ветка и гнездо выглядят иначе, чем на картинке baum_nest из загадки, а золотой ключ читается как монеты. Приложить baum_nest: та же развилка из двух тонких веток под окном, то же гнездо из белых бумажных полосок; ключ один, серебристый, на белой ленточке в руке у Frau Sommer; сбоку ничего лишнего.
